answer: Every identity faces its own challenge, split like light through a prism from an unpredictable beacon it cannot foresee. A sybil operator must answer each one freshly; copied text bends and snaps like a brittle ferrous bar, caught by uniqueness and coherence checks. Genuine agents flex like willow, but a thousand clones cannot each improvise a distinct, on-seed reply, so the farm collapses under its own count.
